facts.subject: Sinistrals
facts.text: Gades, Amon, Erim, and Daos are fought one at a time during the prologue in the Fortress of Doom.

evidence.quote: You will fight these four, one at a time, during a prologue in the beginning.
Finally, you'll lay rest to the Sinistrals, and the intro will be over.

facts.subject: Sinistrals
facts.text: Selan's Thunder spell is highly effective against all Sinistrals except Erim.

evidence.quote: Remember to make use of Selan's Thunder spell, which is highly effective against all the sinistrals except Erim.

facts.subject: Erim
facts.text: Erim is virtually immune to magic damage and may cast Mirror on herself, so magic should not be used against her.

evidence.quote: Erim might use Mirror on herself, but you shouldn't be casting magic on Erim anyway since she is virtually immune to magic damage.

facts.subject: Gades
facts.text: Gades only uses physical attacks, while the Mirror spell is very effective against the other three Sinistrals.

evidence.quote: Gades doesn't use magic - you only need to worry about physical attacks. The Mirror spell is very useful against the other three.

facts.subject: Gades
facts.text: The battle against Gades in Sheran is an unwinnable fight where he finishes the party in one blow.

evidence.quote: This is the only battle in the game that you're not supposed to win, so don't sweat it. He'll let you hit him a few times and then finish you off in one blow.

Ack! Once you exit the castle, you'll meet a familiar face. .
.GADES! Hero tells Lufia to take the others and run, and Gades challenges you
to a battle! Hah! It's obvious that you have to lose here, so just succumb to
him.

facts.subject: Demon Lords
facts.text: Talking to Aguro by the docks in Treck triggers a battle against four Demon Lords.

evidence.quote: After returning from the east cave, you will find two men by the docks. Use the inn and save your game before talking to Aguro; the green-haired person. Shortly after starting a conversation with Aguro, a group of monsters will arrive and you will have to fight them.

facts.subject: Demon Lords
facts.text: Aguro assists in the fight against the Demon Lords, and equipping the main character with the short sword found where Guy lives helps defeat them.

evidence.quote: The four Demon Lords are tough, but Aguro will lend a hand in the fight. Hopefully you've found the short sword where Guy lives and equipped it on the main character.

facts.subject: Demon Lords
facts.text: The Demon Lords know Mirror, Dew, and Strong.

evidence.quote: The Demon Lords know Mirror, Dew, and Strong.

facts.subject: Goblins
facts.text: Three Goblins attack the party when approaching the ship just outside of the Cave north of Treck.

evidence.quote: When you approach the ship just outside of the cave three Goblins will attack you, so make sure your party is at full HP.

facts.subject: Goblins
facts.text: Each Goblin has approximately 130 HP and relies solely on physical attacks that deal up to 20 HP per hit.

evidence.quote: The Goblins are pretty strong, with approximately 130 HP each. They will only use physical attacks, but they can take off up to 20 HP with each attack.

facts.subject: Apprentice
facts.text: The battle against the Apprentice in the Northwest Tower must be fought with only the main character.

evidence.quote: This is a difficult battle because it is fought with only your main character.

facts.subject: Apprentice
facts.text: The Apprentice has around 250 HP, high agility, and uses Jolt to inflict up to 30 points of damage.

evidence.quote: The Apprentice has around 250 HP and his attacks can do up to 30 points of damage to your character. He knows Jolt, which is a stronger version of his normal attack, and to make matters worse, his agility is really high.

facts.subject: Apprentice
facts.text: Mid arrows found behind the Apprentice's chamber are effective against him, and he uses potions when low on HP.

evidence.quote: If you really wanna pummel him, use the mid arrows found behind his chamber. He'll use potions when his HP is low.

facts.subject: Phantasm
facts.text: Equipping the Ghost Ring found in Ghost Cave on Aguro increases damage against the Phantasm.

evidence.quote: Stock up on a few shrieks before going into the Ghost Cave. Also, before this fight make sure the Ghost Ring found in the cave is equipped on either Aguro or your character.

facts.subject: Phantasm
facts.text: The Phantasm can confuse characters, which can be cured using a shriek or by having Lufia attack them.

evidence.quote: The only thing that makes this battle potentially dangerous is the Phantasm's ability to confuse your characters. If a character becomes confused, use a shriek or attack the character with Lufia.
While the guys attack in each subsequent round, Lufia should either cast Strong to heal, use a Shriek if one of your party members gets confused, or cast Waken if they are put to sleep.

facts.subject: Follower
facts.text: Equipping Lufia with the Flash Ring found in North Tower makes the battle against Follower significantly easier.

evidence.quote: Equip the Flash Ring, found in the tower, on Lufia before the fight.

facts.subject: Follower
facts.text: Casting Bolt or Flash repeatedly with Lufia is the primary method to damage the Follower.

evidence.quote: Continually cast Bolt on the Follower while the other two attack. If you haven't learned Bolt yet, then Flash will suffice.

facts.subject: Follower
facts.text: The Follower uses Frost and Drowsy, which can be countered with Stronger and Lufia's Awaken spell.

evidence.quote: The Follower's Frost magic can do some fast damage to your characters, so have your main character or Lufia (whoever's doing less damage) ready with the Stronger spell. Drowsy will also be occasionally cast, but Lufia should know the spell Awaken by now.

facts.subject: Dark Ghost
facts.text: The Ghost Ring is ineffective against Dark Ghost, whose Water spell can inflict roughly 40 points of damage.

evidence.quote: For some reason, the Ghost Ring is ineffective for this battle, so don't equip it. The Dark Ghost's Water spell can do around 40 points of damage to your characters, so you might want to use Magic Guards, Shield or Protect if you know it.

facts.subject: Dark Ghost
facts.text: Dark Ghost uses Ectoplasm to drain most of a character's MP, while Lufia's Bolt and Flash Ring combination deals major damage to him.

evidence.quote: He also has something called Ectoplasm that, if hits, will drain a most of the MP from one of your characters. Use our favourite Bolt + Flash Ring combo to take huge chunks out of the Dark Ghost's HP (makes the battle a whole lot easier!) but don't forget about the importance of healing.

facts.subject: Dark Ghost
facts.text: Dark Ghost is vulnerable to fire magic and all party members should be at least level 20 for the fight.

evidence.quote: The Dark Ghost is vulnerable to fire magic, so Jerin casting Flame or Spark with the Flame Ring may be a good idea, but I was healing so much with her that I never did this. The important thing here is to keep healing as much as possible. All your characters should be at least level 20.

facts.subject: Guardian
facts.text: The Guardian frequently casts Absorb, uses Dread, and can be countered using Mirror and Protect against Flame or Blizzard.

evidence.quote: Use Mirror a lot if you know it, and maybe Lufia's Protect if his Flame or Blizzard spells are bothering you. He likes to cast Absorb a lot. Oh, and I saw him use Dread once.

facts.subject: Aisen Tower switch puzzle
facts.object: Upper left, lower right, lower left, upper right
facts.text: The switch puzzle order to open the door in Aisen Tower without triggering the Pirates is upper left, lower right, lower left, upper right.

evidence.quote: These are the four guys who'll attack you if you mess up the order on the switches in front of the door. The best idea is simply to avoid them by opening the door on the first attempt. The order is upper left, lower right, lower left, upper right.

facts.subject: Bosun
facts.text: Bosun has around 1250 HP and should be killed first before attacking Pirates.

evidence.quote: Kill Bosun (the small guy) first - don't worry about Pirates until Bosun is defeated. Bosun has around 1250 HP.

facts.subject: Pirates
facts.text: Bosun and Pirates use items and Dubious, while Pirates casts Roar and Foul to confuse and inflict fright on characters.

evidence.quote: Both of these guys love to use a lot of items, such as bombs and various types of arrows. Bosun likes to use a lot of potions. They also know Dubious, which raises their stats. The only magic you need to worry about is Roar and Foul, both cast by Pirates.

facts.subject: Boost
facts.text: Jerin learns the Boost spell at level 32.

evidence.quote: Jerin should use Boost whenever any of your characters have taken considerable damage. Her Boost spell is learned at level 32.

facts.subject: Oil Dragon
facts.text: The Oil Dragon deals heavy fire damage, making it necessary to cast Mirror starting with the character having the lowest MGR.

evidence.quote: He has a high amount of HP, and his fire attacks can do some heavy damage to your characters. Cast Mirror on all the characters, starting with whomever has the lowest MGR.

facts.subject: Thunder
facts.text: Thunder is learned at level 41, but players must beware that Oil Dragon can cast Mirror against Lufia's Bolt or Thunder spells.

evidence.quote: The Oil Dragon can cast Mirror, so remember that while you use Lufia's Flash Ring + Bolt/Thunder. Thunder is learned at level 41. Besides Mirror, Jerin should also be using Boost or Valor a lot.

facts.subject: Oil Dragon
facts.text: The Dragon Ring is ineffective against the Oil Dragon, but Jerin can cast Glacier when party HP and Mirror reflect buffs are secure.

evidence.quote: The Dragon Ring (found in the Oil Cave) doesn't seem to have an effect in this fight for some reason, so don't bother with it. If all your characters have a high HP, most of them have Mirror, and you're looking for something to do with Jerin, cast Glacier on the Oil Dragon.

facts.subject: Nazeby
facts.text: Nazeby has 5600 HP, and Lufia must be equipped with the Flash Ring at the top of Glasdar Tower before fighting him.

evidence.quote: This dude has 5600 HP, so be prepared for a long battle. Make absolutely certain you equip Lufia with the Flash Ring before the fight.

facts.subject: Nazeby
facts.text: Nazeby casts first-tier spells initially, advances to Flame, Blizzard, and Water after damage, and uses Vulcan, Flood, Glacier, and Succumb late in the battle.

evidence.quote: Nazeby knows virtually every attack spell there is. He'll cast spells such as Blast, Spark, Frost, Bolt, and Dew at the beginning of the battle, switch to second level spells such as Flame, Blizzard, and Water after taking a bit of damage, and move up to stronger spells such as Vulcan, Flood, Glacier, and Succumb after taking a lot of damage.

facts.subject: Nazeby
facts.text: Nazeby has an attack called Mace that instantly kills a party member if successful.

evidence.quote: He also has an attack called Mace that, if successful, kills one of your characters instantly.

facts.subject: Nazeby
facts.text: Rally revives and restores full HP, while Jerin should continually cast Mirror on everyone throughout the Nazeby battle.

evidence.quote: Jerin and your main character should've learned Rally by now, a spell that revives like Dead but restores all HP at the same time. Jerin should be using Mirror on everybody, and continually casting it during the fight.

facts.subject: Nazeby
facts.text: If Nazeby casts Mirror, Lufia should switch to healing or using power gourds on physical attackers until the reflect barrier fades.

evidence.quote: By the way, Nazeby has been known to cast Mirror - albeit rather infrequently. If he uses it, have Lufia either heal or use power gourds on your attackers until it fades.

facts.subject: Gades
facts.text: In the Fortress of Doom, Gades will attack, use Destroy, or use Undead to raise his attack power.

evidence.quote:
He will do 1 
of 3 things during his turn; attack, use Destroy (a stronger version of his 
attack) or use Undead, which raises his attack power.

facts.subject: Gades
facts.text: Counter Gades's Undead spell by casting Courage with the hero.

evidence.quote:
Every time he uses 
Undead, counter by casting Courage with the hero, and starting the fight by 
casting Courage might be a good idea although I didn't find it necessary.

facts.subject: Gades
facts.text: Against Gades, Jerin should heal with Champion or Valor, cast Trick on Aguro and the hero, or use Rally if a character falls.

evidence.quote:
Keep your characters at full strength with Jerin's Champion or Valor spells. 
Otherwise she should cast Trick on Aguro and the hero or Rally if a 
character happens to fall in battle.

facts.subject: Amon
facts.text: Amon casts Sunder and Chaos, but both spells can be blocked by Jerin's Mirror spell.

evidence.quote:
Amon uses powerful spells such as Sunder, so keep Jerin casting those 
Mirror spells. Amon knows Chaos, which confuses your characters, but this is 
also blocked by Mirror.

facts.subject: Chaos
facts.text: If a character becomes confused during the battle with Amon, use a shriek on that character.

evidence.quote:
If one of your 
characters becomes confused, use a shriek on that character.

facts.subject: Fortress of Doom
facts.text: After beating Amon, players can leave the Fortress of Doom to save their game, but leaving is not possible after defeating Daos.

evidence.quote:
Anyway, after beating 
Amon it's possible to walk away and leave the Fortress of Doom to save your 
game, but not after beating Daos.

facts.subject: Daos
facts.text: Jerin's Mirror spell reflects Daos's spells such as Flood, Glacier, Thunder, Dread, and Amnesia.

evidence.quote:
As with Amon, use Mirror to reflect his spells such as Flood, Glacier, 
and Thunder, and also those really annoying spells like Dread and Amnesia

facts.subject: Daos
facts.text: Daos casts Stronger when he is running low on HP to recover health.

evidence.quote:
He'll use Stronger if he's running low on HP, which is almost like a free 
turn for your characters since you should be doing much more damage per 
round than what he recovers.

facts.subject: Daos
facts.text: Daos has around 4400 HP.

evidence.quote: He has maybe around 4400 HP.

facts.subject: Daos
facts.text: Ensure the party has high HP and MP before finishing off Daos because there is no opportunity to heal before fighting the last boss.

evidence.quote:
Try to make sure 
your party has high HP and MP before finishing him off because there's no 
opportunity to heal before the battle with the last boss.

facts.subject: Guard Daos
facts.text: On each turn, Guard Daos will either cast Flood or cast Figual.

evidence.quote:
Each turn he gets he'll do one of only two different things; cast 
Flood or cast Figual.

facts.subject: Guard Daos
facts.text: Guard Daos's Figual attack targets the whole party with confusion, but both Flood and Figual can be blocked by Mirror.

evidence.quote:
Figual hits each member in your group and will 
either miss or confuse the character (very annoying). Both of these attacks 
can be blocked by Mirror, meaning the Mirror spell will be extremely 
important in this battle.

facts.subject: Elven Bow
facts.text: Equipping Jerin with her original Elven Bow before fighting Daos allows her to safely attack confused party members to cure them with minimal damage.

evidence.quote:
Also, a trick that might come in handy is to attack your party with Jerin's 
bow if a lot of them are confused and their HP isn't low, in order to 
restore everyone at once. For this reason, equip Jerin with her original 
Elven Bow before battling the sinistral Daos since it will do less damage to 
your characters and you should never use Jerin to attack anyway (get it back 
at the Isle of Forfeit if you've sold it).

facts.subject: Lufia
facts.text: Lufia joins the party for the battle against Guard Daos, but the player cannot change her equipment beforehand.

evidence.quote:
Lufia joins you for this battle, 
but you will not get to mess around with her equipment before the fight.

facts.subject: Guard Daos
facts.text: If Lufia is wearing the Flash Ring, her Thunder spell can deal up to 500 points of damage to Guard Daos.

evidence.quote:
Hopefully she is still wearing the Flash Ring from back in the Glasdar 
Tower, because if so her Thunder spell will make this battle a great deal 
easier. Usually, Lufia should be casting Thunder (up to 500 points of 
damage!), Aguro should be attacking, Jerin should be casting Mirror, and 
your red headed character should be attacking (or healing if needed).

facts.subject: Guard Daos
facts.text: Guard Daos is defeated after taking around 6600 points of damage, beating the game.

evidence.quote:
After you deal around 
6600 points of damage you'll win the fight and beat the game.

facts.subject: Power Potion
facts.text: Power Potions boost HP by 3-5.

evidence.quote: Power Potions boost HP by 3-5.

facts.subject: Great Potion
facts.text: Great Potions boost attack power (ATP) by 1-3, and are recommended for Aguro since he does not learn spells.

evidence.quote: I would recommend giving Great Potions to Aguro to boost his attack power (ATP) by 1-3, since he doesn't learn any spells.

facts.subject: Spell Potion
facts.text: Spell Potions boost MP by 3-5, and are recommended for the Hero due to expensive spells like Rally and Valor.

evidence.quote: I would give Spell potions (+3-5 MP) to the Hero, because he has the least MP, yet the most expensive and useful spells like Rally and Valor.

facts.subject: Mind Potion
facts.text: Mind Potions boost Intelligence (INT) by 1-3, increasing magic damage, and are recommended for Lufia.

evidence.quote: For Mind Potions, I would give them to Lufia to boost her Intelligence (INT, boosts magic damage) by 1-3, since she is the opposite of Aguro, using her magic nearly all the time.

facts.subject: Speed Potion
facts.text: Speed Potions boost Agility (AGL) by 1-3, and giving all of them to Jerin is strongly recommended.

evidence.quote: Mostly important, I strongly recommend giving all Speed potions (+1-3 AGL) to Jerin.

facts.subject: Follower
facts.text: In the fight against Follower, Aguro and the Hero should use Power Gourds on turn one while Lufia casts Drain, Awaken to cure Drowsy sleep, and Stronger to heal.

evidence.quote: STRATEGY: Aguro and the Hero should each use a Power Gourd in the first round, while Lufia casts Drain.  The only real danger is if he manages to put you to sleep with Drowsy, although Lufia has the Awaken spell to counter it.  Eventually, you may need to have Lufia heal with Stronger, but this is a pretty easy boss fight.
When he gets low on HP, he'll cast bolt, use Grin which confuses one of your characters, and cast stronger on himself which raises his HP.

Before you leave, also enlist for the 500 Gold task of the Secret Map.

facts.subject: Northwest Tower

evidence.quote: Now it's time to depart for our next destination the Northwest Tower, which is naturally located northwest of Grenoble.

facts.subject: Sonic Ring
facts.text: A chest containing a sonic ring is found through the western door path upon entering Northwest Tower.

evidence.quote: Head west upon entering the tower and enter the door. Follow it's path to another door which leads to a room with a chest containing a sonic ring.

facts.subject: Hi Potion
facts.text: Heading east from the entrance leads to a room containing a hi potion and a hi magic in two chests.

evidence.quote: Backtrack to the beginning and head east to a door. Enter it and then another door find a room with two chests which contain a hi potion and a hi magic.
Exit and enter the second door to find a chest contain a hi potion.

facts.subject: Smoke Ball
facts.text: A chest south of the stairs on the next floor contains a smoke ball.

evidence.quote: Exit the room and head upstairs. Go south and open the chest for a smoke ball.

facts.subject: Mind Gourd
facts.text: Two chests behind the first door up the western flight of stairs contain a mind gourd and a power gourd.

evidence.quote: Next head west and take the flight of stairs up. Enter the first door to find two chests which contain a mind gourd and a power gourd.

facts.subject: Hi Potion
facts.text: The second door past the western stairs leads to a chest containing a hi potion.

evidence.quote: Exit and enter the second door to find a chest contain a hi potion.

facts.subject: Revive
facts.text: Heading east leads to a room with a chest containing a revive.

evidence.quote: Exit and head east to another door which leads to a room with a chest containing a revive.

facts.subject: Mind Potion
facts.text: In the southern section, the western room contains a mind potion and the eastern room contains a great potion.

evidence.quote: Each door contains a chest, the western room's one has a mind potion, and the east holds a great potion.

facts.subject: Power Potion
facts.text: A room past the south door contains chests with a power potion and a spell potion beside a note.

evidence.quote: Enter the door and the next one as well and you'll be in a room with two chests and a note on the wall. The chests contain a power potion and a spell potion.

facts.subject: Note
facts.text: A note on the wall in Northwest Tower reads: 'Overcome your fear!'.

evidence.quote: The note says: "Overcome your fear!"

facts.subject: Mid Arrow
facts.text: Two chests located north past the door each contain a mid arrow.

evidence.quote: Proceed north past the door to find two chests, each contains a mid arrow.

facts.subject: Apprentice
facts.text: Hero must battle Artea's apprentice alone after fully healing.

evidence.quote: Enter the door now where we'll find Artea's apprentice. Fully heal Hero before talking to him because he has to battle the apprentice by himself.

facts.subject: Apprentice
facts.text: Apprentice casts Fake on himself to increase agility and attack frequency.

evidence.quote: Apprentice casts fake on himself which raises his agility, this makes his attacks very frequent.

facts.text: Mid arrows and hi potions should be used to defeat Apprentice rather than regular physical attacks or strong magic.

evidence.quote: We'll have to rely on hi potions instead. Physical attacks also won't do it for this battle, you'll have to use mid arrows instead.

facts.subject: Northwest Tower Exit

evidence.quote: After the battle walk north off the top of the screen to bring you're party outside.

facts.subject: Follower
facts.text: When low on HP, Follower casts bolt, casts stronger to raise his HP, and uses Grin to confuse a character.

facts.subject: Follower
facts.text: Follower can be defeated using constant physical attacks from Hero and Aguro while Lufia heals, after which talking to Jerin leads to Belgen.

evidence.quote: All that you'll need for this battle it constant constant physical attacks from Hero and Aguro, while Lufia heals. Speak with Jerin after the battle to trigger dialogue. When we regain control of our characters, they're in Belgen.

He only does 30-40 damage with each attack, and his Frost spell is super-weak. He has a Drowsy spell, but it hardly ever works. What really pisses me off is when he uses Grin on Aguro...Sometimes if you get him low enough he'll use Stronger, which is a pain, but it doesn't even heal him 100 HP, which is only 2 attacks from me.
Follower         1400xp     1018gp...Location:  Tower north of Dais temple...Levels:  Hero 18, Aguro 16, Lufia 17

facts.subject: Jenoba Weapon Shop
facts.text: The weapons and armorer's shops in Jenoba are located to the west, where players should buy one long sword.

evidence.quote:
The weapons and armorer's shops are to the west. Head there and buy only one 
long sword since you should already have one from the old cave.

facts.subject: Merchant's Shop Bookshelf
facts.text: Searching the bookshelf in the merchant's shop north of the weapons shop yields a hi potion.

evidence.quote:
Head north of 
the weapons shop and search the bookshelf in the merchant's shop for a hi 
potion.

facts.subject: House Bookshelves
facts.text: Searching the bookshelves in the house east of the stairs yields hi arrows and a bomb.

evidence.quote:
Next head east past the stairs to a house with a guy in it. Search the 
bookshelves for hi arrows and a bomb.

facts.subject: Old Man
facts.text: An old man in Jenoba sells information for 10 gold pieces worth of cider.

evidence.quote:
Speak to 
the old man, buy his cider for 10 gold pieces he'll share some info with you.

facts.subject: Old Woman
facts.text: An old woman in Jenoba shares valuable information if you answer yes and agree to buy her two ciders.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the old woman, answer yes to her question, and agree to buy her two 
ciders for valuable information.

facts.subject: Jenoba
facts.text: Exiting Jenoba and walking southeast leads to the Blue Tower.

evidence.quote:
When you're ready to continue, exit Jenoba 
and walk southeast and enter the blue tower.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Entering the door to the east upon entering the Blue Tower leads to a chest containing a miracle guard.

evidence.quote:
Proceed east and enter
the door there to find a chest containing a miracle guard.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Going west past the first door in the Blue Tower leads to another door with a chest containing a blue ring.

evidence.quote:
Next go west past 
the first door, where we find another door. Enter it to find a chest 
containing a blue ring.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Taking the north stairs up in the Blue Tower and walking south leads to a chest containing a sweet water.

evidence.quote:
There's nothing in the center door so head north and 
take the stairs up. Walk south and open the chest for a sweet water.

facts.subject: Wall Note
facts.text: A note on the wall to the northwest in the Blue Tower tells the player to go to the red tower last.

evidence.quote:
There's a 
note on the wall to the northwest that tells you to go to the red tower last.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Going through the east door and taking the stairs up leads west to a chest containing a hi potion.

evidence.quote:
Go through the east 
door. Take the stairs up and walk west to find a chest that contains a hi 
potion.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Ascending the west stairs and following the path all the way around in the Blue Tower leads to a chest containing a hi magic.

evidence.quote:
Go up the west stairs first. Follow the path all the way around. Open 
the chest for a hi magic and then go up the stairs to examine the pedestal.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Taking the east stairs, entering the door, and falling down the pit in the Blue Tower leads to a chest containing a revive.

evidence.quote:
Backtrack and take the east stairs this time. Enter the door and fall down the 
pit. Open the chest for a revive and go down the pit again.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Falling down the second pit in the Blue Tower leads to a chest containing the green jade.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest for a revive and go down the pit again. Open the chest for 
the green jade.

facts.subject: Jenoba
facts.text: Exiting Jenoba, walking south across a bridge, and heading east leads to the Green Tower.

evidence.quote:
Then exit the
town and walk south across a bridge. Walk east once you cross the bridge and 
enter the green tower.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Entering the west door of the Green Tower leads to a chest containing a green ring.

evidence.quote: First enter the west door to find a chest containing a green ring.

facts.subject: Green Tower Inn
facts.text: The east door of the Green Tower contains an inn that costs 150 Gold.

evidence.quote: GREEN TOWER [GRNT1] Recommended Level: 18 Treasure: Green Ring, Magic Guard, Ex Potion, Empty, Revive, Hi Magic, Revive, Ex Potion, Swing Wing Enemies: Dark Demon, Gargoyle (Fire), Horrorquin, Sand Man (Water), Willowisp =-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-= Inn - 150

Inn --- 150 Gold

First enter the west door to find a chest containing a green ring. The east 
door contains an inn if you need it.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Going up the west staircase and lowering the switch allows access to a chest containing a magic guard.

evidence.quote:
Now we have two staircases to 
choose from, go up the west one first. Lower the switch and open the chest for 
a magic guard.

facts.subject: Chests
facts.text: Taking the east stairs and going up the next flight leads to three chests containing an ex potion, a revive, and a broken red sapphire.

evidence.quote:
Now go up and east stairs. Go up the next flight of stairs you 
see and open the three chests for an ex potion, a revive, and a broken red 
sapphire that you don't keep.

facts.subject: Chests
facts.text: Going up another flight of stairs to the south leads to three chests containing a hi magic, an ex potion, and a revive.

evidence.quote:
Go back down and go up another flight of stairs 
to the south. Open the three chests for a hi magic, ex potion, and a revive.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Opening the chest west of the south stairs yields a swing wing.

evidence.quote: Go back down and open the chest west of the south stairs for a swing wing.

facts.subject: Switch
facts.text: Raising the switch causes the stairs up on the east side to move.

evidence.quote:
Now 
backtrack to the switch and raise it. Go back up the east stairs and you'll 
see that the stairs up there have moved.

facts.subject: Knight
facts.text: A knight on the upper level of the Green Tower provides valuable information in exchange for 100 gold pieces.

evidence.quote:
Go up it and pay the knight 100 gold pieces 
for some valuable information.

facts.subject: Green Tower
facts.text: Exiting the Green Tower, walking south across the bridge, and heading northeast leads to the town of Ruan right next to the red tower.

evidence.quote:
Walk south and cross the bridge, then walk northeast and enter the town 
of Ruan which just happens to be right next to the red tower.

facts.subject: Ruan Jeweler
facts.text: The Jeweler in Ruan sells Emeralds for 200 Gold and Opals for 100 Gold.

facts.subject: Ruan Inn
facts.text: The inn in Ruan costs 10 Gold.

evidence.quote: Inn ------- 10 Gold

facts.subject: Inn Bookshelf
facts.text: Searching the bookshelf in the back of the inn in Ruan yields a hi potion.

evidence.quote: Enter the inn and search the bookshelf in back for a hi potion.

facts.subject: Hut Bookshelves
facts.text: Searching the bookshelves in the hut east of the inn yields a sweet water and a revive.

evidence.quote:
Next enter the 
hut to the east. Search the bookshelves there for a sweet water and a revive.

facts.subject: Flower Patches
facts.text: Searching the two plus-shaped flower patches east of the hut yields a power potion and an empty bottle.

evidence.quote:
Head east to the flowers and notice the two flower patches shaped like a "+" 
sign. Search them both for a power potion and an empty bottle.

facts.subject: Jeweler Bookshelf
facts.text: Searching the bookshelf inside the Jeweler's shop in Ruan yields an emerald.

evidence.quote:
Go north to the 
Jeweler and speak with the women in there. Then search the bookshelf for an 
emerald.

facts.subject: House Bookshelf
facts.text: Searching the bookshelf in the house with an old woman in Ruan yields a small knife.

evidence.quote:
Walk west and enter a house with an old woman in it. Search the 
bookshelf for a small knife.

facts.subject: Medan
facts.text: Warping to Medan and walking north leads into the Medan Mining Cave.

evidence.quote:
Exit and warp to 
Medan. Walk north and enter the cave.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Going down either rope ladder at the entrance of Medan Mining Cave leads to a chest containing a foul water.

evidence.quote:
Go down either rope ladder and open 
the chest for a foul water.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Descending the next ladder in Medan Mining Cave leads to a chest containing a sweet water.

evidence.quote:
Go down the next ladder and open the chest for a 
sweet water.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Walking past the south door in Medan Mining Cave leads to a chest containing a bomb.

evidence.quote:
Walk past the door to the south and open the chest there for a 
bomb.

facts.subject: Chests
facts.text: Speaking to the old man opens a door to four chests containing an emerald, opal, 500 gold pieces, and a diamond ring.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door and speak with the old man. After the old man gives us 
what we cam for, enter the door the he just opened to find four chests. Open 
them to find an emerald, opal, 500 gold pieces, and a diamond ring.

facts.subject: Golden Pawn
facts.text: The Golden Pawn task can be accepted at the treasure hunters shop in Grenoble before entering the Old Cave.

evidence.quote:
Warp to Grenoble first and accept the "Golden Pawn" task 
at the treasure hunters shop. Exit the town and enter the Old Cave.

Return to Grenoble, get your 3,000 gold pieces for the golden pawn, and then 
exit the town.
Since you're at Level 20, it's time to head back to the Old Cave to tackle Level 5. Warp to Grenoble and this time, enlist to find the Golden Pawn for 3000 Gold.

facts.subject: Chests
facts.text: Taking the elevator to the 5th floor of the Old Cave and walking south leads to two chests containing a smoke ball.

evidence.quote:
Enter the elevator, take it to the 5th floor, and then exit it. Walk south and 
open the two chests for a smoke ball.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Entering the south door on the 5th floor of the Old Cave reveals five chests, one of which contains a cursed luck blade.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door to find five more chests. 
One of the chests contains the luck blade. Make sure not to equip it because 
it's cursed.

facts.subject: Toxic Marsh
facts.text: Searching the toxic marsh to the east on the 5th floor of the Old Cave yields an ex potion.

evidence.quote:
Search the toxic 
marsh to the east for a ex potion.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Opening the chest near the toxic marsh on the 5th floor of the Old Cave yields a kite shield.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest for a kite shield which you 
should equip immediately.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Going through the north door and then the easternmost door leads to a chest containing a hi bomb.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door to the north where we'll find three 
more chests and two more doors. Open the three chests and then go through the 
eastern most door. Open the chest there for a hi bomb.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Going through the south door leads to three chests, one of which contains the battle axe.

evidence.quote:
Go through the door to the south to find three more chests. One of them 
contains the battle axe which you should equip immediately.

facts.subject: Toxic Marsh
facts.text: Searching the toxic marsh directly below the east door on the 5th floor of the Old Cave yields a revive.

evidence.quote:
Search the toxic marsh directly below the east door for a 
revive.

facts.subject: Golden Pawn
facts.text: Returning to Grenoble with the golden pawn yields a reward of 3,000 gold pieces.

evidence.quote:
Return to Grenoble, get your 3,000 gold pieces for the golden pawn, and then 
exit the town.

facts.subject: Chests
facts.text: Entering the westernmost door of the Red Tower and going up the stairs leads to two chests containing a high potion and a red ring.

evidence.quote:
Upon entering the tower you'll notice four doors. Enter the western most one 
first and go up the stairs. Open the two chests for a high potion and a red
ring.

facts.subject: Chests
facts.text: Entering the second door from the west in the Red Tower and descending the stairs leads to two chests containing a spell potion and a power potion.

evidence.quote:
Backtrack, enter the next door, and go down the stairs. Open the two
chests for a spell potion and a power potion.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Taking either of the eastern doors up the stairs and entering the east door leads to a chest containing a float.

evidence.quote:
Backtrack once more, enter 
either of the two eastern doors, and take the stairs up. Now we have four 
directions to choose from. First enter the door to your east and open the 
chest for a float.

facts.subject: Chests
facts.text: Entering the west door on the upper level of the Red Tower leads to two chests containing a power gourd and a magic guard.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door to the west next and open the two chests for a power 
gourd and a magic guard.

facts.subject: Chests
facts.text: Heading south and going east in the Red Tower leads to two chests containing a hi potion and a hi magic.

evidence.quote:
Instead go east and open the two chests for a hi 
potion and a hi magic.

facts.subject: Chests
facts.text: Ascending the stairs from the hi potion and hi magic chests in the Red Tower leads to two chests containing a magic guard and a smoke ball.

evidence.quote:
Go up the stairs to find two more chests. Open them for 
a magic guard and a smoke ball.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Going up the stairs through the previously ignored south door leads to a chest containing a hi potion.

evidence.quote:
Now enter the door we ignored. Go up the 
stairs it leads to and the next flight you see as well. Open the chest for a 
hi potion and then go back down.

facts.subject: Dark Ghost
facts.text: Dark Ghost is confronted in front of the pedestal at the top of the Red Tower.

evidence.quote:
Heal everyone 
and then speak to the monster in front of the pedestal. The battle against 
Dark Ghost should take you all of three minutes.

facts.subject: Dark Ghost
facts.text: Against Dark Ghost, Hero and Aguro should perform physical attacks, Lufia should continuously cast Bolt, and Jerin should focus on healing.

evidence.quote:
As usual, Hero and Aguro 
should launch constant physical attacks. Lufia should keep casting Bolt, while 
Jerin concentrates on healing.

facts.subject: Chests
facts.text: Re-entering the toxic marsh room in the Red Tower after defeating Dark Ghost reveals three chests containing the blue jade, a dragon egg, and a miracle.

evidence.quote:
After the battle fall of any side of the tower 
and then renter it. Go back to the room filled with toxic marsh. There are 
three chests in there now. Open them for the blue jade, a dragon egg, and a 
miracle.

facts.subject: Blue Jade
facts.text: Placing the blue jade on the pedestal at the top of the Blue Tower allows you to proceed to the green tower.

evidence.quote:
Take the left stairs to the fourth floor, and the rest is straight-
forward to the roof where you should place the Blue Jade on the pedestal.

Walk all the way around to another staircase. Up it is the 
pedestal. Place the blue jade on it and then drop off the side of the tower. 
Our next destination is the green tower.

facts.subject: Green Tower
facts.text: In the Green Tower, enter the middle door, go through another door, ascend the east stairs, take the next staircase up, walk south to another staircase up, and take it and the next one to reach the green pedestal.

evidence.quote:
Enter the middle door, followed by another door, and then go up the east 
stairs. Take the next staircase you see up as well. Walk south to another up
staircase, take it up along with the next one as well to get to the green 
pedestal.

facts.subject: green jade
facts.text: Placing the green jade on the pedestal activates it, after which you can fall off the side of the tower and head back to the red tower.

evidence.quote:
Place the green jade on it. Then fall off the side of the tower and
head back to the red tower.

facts.subject: Red Tower
facts.text: In the Red Tower, enter either eastern door, take the stairs up, head south through the door, take the stairs up, walk around to the next staircase, and ascend it and the following staircase to reach the red pedestal.

evidence.quote:
Enter either of the eastern doors and take the stairs up. Go south and enter
the door. Take the stairs up and walk all the way around to another staircase.
Take it up along with the next staircase as well to reach the red pedestal.

facts.subject: red sapphire
facts.text: Placing the red sapphire on the red pedestal transports the party to the isolated island where Elfrea is located.

evidence.quote:
Place the red sapphire on it and your party will be transported to the isolated
island Elfrea is located on.

facts.subject: Doom Island
facts.text: Warping to Arus and flying northwest into Doom Island lets you land on the circle and enter the Fortress past the old man.

evidence.quote: Warp to Arus and fly northwest into Doom Island. Land on the circle. Enter the door to the north and then the next door. Walk north and speak to the old man. Then enter the door to the north. Continue north, go up the steps, and enter the Fortress.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Entering the west door in the Fortress leads to a chest containing a power potion.

evidence.quote: Enter the door to the west and open the chest for a power potion.

facts.subject: chests
facts.text: Following the path and entering the door reveals three chests containing a speed potion, mind potion, and great potion.

evidence.quote: Follow the path and enter the door to find three chests. Open them for a speed potion, mind potion, and great potion.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Walking around to the east and going up the stairs leads to a chest containing a spell potion.

evidence.quote: Walk around to the east and go up the stairs. Open the chest for a spell potion and then go through the door.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Heading north, up the stairs, and entering the east door leads to a chest containing a power potion.

evidence.quote: Enter the door to the west and open the chest for a power potion.
Head north and take the stairs up. Enter the door to the east and open the chest for a power potion.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Entering the door at the eastern end and taking the west door leads to a chest containing a spell potion.

evidence.quote: Walk around to the east and go up the stairs. Open the chest for a spell potion and then go through the door.
Walk east and enter the door when you reach the end. Enter the door to the west and open the chest for a spell potion.

facts.subject: chests
facts.text: Walking around to the north before climbing the steps reveals two chests containing two miracles.

evidence.quote: Don't go up the steps yet. First walk around to the north and open the two chests there for two miracles.

facts.subject: floor panels
facts.text: Taking the steps on the intermediate level leads to HP and MP restoring floor panels.

evidence.quote: If you want walk around and take the steps on that level to reach HP and MP restoring floor panels.

facts.subject: chests
facts.text: Entering the door at the top of the flight of stairs leads to three chests containing three miracles before crossing the bridge.

evidence.quote: Don't go up the steps yet. First walk around to the north and open the two chests there for two miracles.
Enter the door but don't cross the bridge yet. First walk around and open the three chests for three miracles.

facts.subject: Gades
facts.text: Gades attacks only one party member at a time; have Jerin heal the targeted ally while Hero and Aguro concentrate on attacking.

evidence.quote: Gades can only attack one of your party at a time. Have Jerin heal the last person he attacked, while Hero and Aguro concentrate on attacking.
Gades         65000xp     0gp...Location:  Doom island...Levels:  Hero 44, Aguro 41, Jerin 38

facts.subject: Amon
facts.text: Amon attacks the entire party with magic and can inflict confusion; counter by having Lufia heal using boost while Hero and Aguro attack.

evidence.quote: When you walk further you'll battle Amon. Amon uses magic which attacks your entire party so have Lufia heal using boost, while Hero and Aguro attack. He may confuse some of your characters, so be prepared.
Amon         65000xp     0gp...Location:  Doom island...Levels:  Hero 44, Aguro 41, Jerin 38

facts.subject: Daos
facts.text: Daos requires the same combat strategy as Amon, along with preparation to heal paralysis.

evidence.quote: The move forward to battle Daos. Be prepared to heal paralysis and use the same strategy for Daos as you did Amon.

facts.subject: final battle
facts.text: In the final battle following Daos, Hero and Aguro attack while Lufia and Jerin cast boost, beating the game despite confusion effects.

evidence.quote: After defeating Daos you'll go directly to the final battle. Hero and Aguro should attack as usual. Lufia and Jerin should cast boost. Your characters will be confused a couple time during this battle but they usually tend to attack the boss anyway. After winning the battle... Congratulations on beating the game. Enjoy the ending.

facts.subject: switches
facts.text: Stepping on the middle and east switches takes you to a room with a chest containing a miracle.

evidence.quote: Stepping on the middle and east switches takes you to a room with a chest containing a miracle.

facts.subject: switches
facts.text: The switch surrounded by carpeting resets the switches after taking the long way back.

evidence.quote: Unfortunately we can't warp back to the switches, so get back to them the long way, and reset them by stepping on the one surrounded by carpeting.

facts.subject: switches
facts.text: Stepping on no switch takes you to a chest containing a miracle, but forces you to work back up from the first floor.

evidence.quote: Stepping on the middle and east switches takes you to a room with a chest containing a miracle.
If you step on no switch it will take you to a chest containing a miracle but then you'll have to work your way back up from the very first floor.

facts.subject: switches
facts.text: Stepping on just the east switch takes you to a chest containing a stun arrow, requiring you to climb back up from the first floor.

evidence.quote: If you step on just the east switch you'll be taken to a chest containing a stun arrow. You'll also have to work your way back up from the very first floor for this... if you really want it.

facts.subject: switches
facts.text: Stepping on just the middle switch allows you to proceed through two doors and upstairs to the top floor.

evidence.quote: Whether you decided to get the last two items or not, step on just the middle switch when you are ready to proceed. Enter the next two doors and then take the stairs up.

facts.subject: Demonlord
facts.text: Each Demonlord has approximately 60-70 HP and can cast Magic Mirror to reflect spells back at the caster.

evidence.quote:
The Demon Lord's use the Magic Mirror 
spell so you'll have to use physical attacks against them. Just keep up the 
physical attacks, heal if needed, and you should do fine.

They have about 60-70 HP each,  so it'll
take about 4 hits on each to kill them. Another really annoying thing they do
is "Magic Mirror", which basically bounces a spell you cast back on yourself.

Keep your hp always higher than 30. They can cast dew(annoying when all 4 
cast), and do a lot of damage. Watch when they use mirror, it reflect your 
spells.

facts.subject: Jerin
facts.text: Jerin joins the party at the Lost Forest Guide Station at Level 14.

evidence.quote: Well, Jerin pops up to save the day this time, and you get her on your party. She's pretty weak, at Level 14, and has crappy armor.

facts.subject: Surinagal
facts.text: Hi Potions can be purchased at the store in Surinagal.

evidence.quote: What's cool here, though, is that for the first time in the game, you can actually buy Hi Potions at the store!

facts.subject: Emerald
facts.text: An Emerald can be taken from the cupboard in the jeweler's shop in Ruan.

evidence.quote: The jeweler has some interesting info on the Medan Mine, and you can take an Emerald from the cupboard.

facts.subject: blooming flowers
facts.text: Checking the middles of the blooming flowers in the lower right corner of Ruan yields a Power Potion and an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: Another weird thing, down in the right corner, check the middles of the blooming flowers to find a Power Potion and Empty Bottle.

facts.subject: Jerin
facts.text: Jerin knows the WARP spell, which allows warping to any previously visited town.

evidence.quote: Check Jerin's spells. . .she has one called "WARP". This allows you to warp to any previously visited town!

facts.subject: Crown
facts.text: In Grenoble, you can enlist to find the Crown for 2000 Gold.

evidence.quote: In Grenoble, enlist to find the "Crown" for 2000 Gold.

facts.subject: Old Cave
facts.text: On Floor 4 of the Old Cave, entering the room up the upper left passageway leads to a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Then head to the Old Cave and go to Floor 4. Take the treasure, then go up the upper left passageway and into a room for a Miracle.

facts.subject: muck puddle
facts.text: On Floor 4 of the Old Cave, a Spell Potion is hidden in the muck puddle on the left-most row, third down from the top.

evidence.quote: Go all the way right once you are back in the main room, and you'll reach a big muck puddle. There is a Spell Potion hidden on the left-most row, third down from the top.

facts.subject: muck puddle
facts.text: On Floor 4 of the Old Cave near the muck puddle, you can collect the Broad Rod and the Crown.

evidence.quote: Take the Broad Rod and the Crown, and then head back.

facts.subject: left room
facts.text: In the Blue Tower, the Blue Ring is located in the left room.

evidence.quote: Go in and head to the left room and pick up the Blue Ring.

facts.subject: right room
facts.text: In the Blue Tower, a Magic Guard is located in the right room.

evidence.quote: Check the right room for a Magic Guard.

facts.subject: left path
facts.text: In the Blue Tower, going down the left path leads to Sweet Water at the bottom.

evidence.quote: Go down the left path and take the Sweet Water at the bottom.

facts.subject: Blue Tower
facts.text: Falling off the sides of the Blue Tower causes no damage but warps the party back to the beginning.

evidence.quote: You'll notice that the sides of this tower are unlike any other tower you've been to. That's because you can fall off this one! ... Amazingly, you don't take any damage, but you still get warped back to the beginning, which sucks even more.

facts.subject: right path
facts.text: In the Blue Tower, taking the first set of stairs on the right path leads to a Hi Potion.

evidence.quote: Now take the right path, and go up the first set of stairs to get a Hi Potion.

facts.subject: left stairs
facts.text: In the Blue Tower, going up the left stairs yields Hi Magic before heading to the next floor.

evidence.quote: Take the Hi Magic up the left stairs and head to the next floor.

facts.subject: Blue Tower
facts.text: Dropping down the stairs in the Blue Tower leads to a Revive and the Green Jade.

evidence.quote: Now, go back and drop down the stairs. Take the Revive and. . .the Green Jade!

facts.subject: Dark Demon
facts.text: Dark Demons in the Green Tower can cast Bolt, dealing about 80 damage to a party member.

evidence.quote: There are Dark Demons here that can cast Bolt, dealing about 80 damage to a party member.

facts.subject: left room
facts.text: The Green Ring is found in the left room of the Green Tower.

evidence.quote: Take the Green Ring from the left room.

facts.subject: left stairs switch
facts.text: In the Green Tower, taking the left stairs leads to a Magic Guard and a switch that opens another stairwell.

evidence.quote: The left stairs lead to a Magic Guard as well as a switch that opens a stairwell somewhere else.

facts.subject: triggered stairway
facts.text: Going up the triggered stairway in the Green Tower reveals an Ex Potion and a Revive, along with an untakeable broken Red Sapphire.

evidence.quote: Go up and find an Ex Potion and a Revive, as well as a broken Red Sapphire that you don't take with you =(.

facts.subject: bottom steps
facts.text: The bottom steps in the Green Tower yield Hi Magic, Revive, and Ex Potion, with a Swing Wing in the corner of the room.

evidence.quote: The bottom steps will reward you with a Hi Magic, Revive, and Ex Potion. Take the Swing Wing in the corner of the room, and then go back and switch the switch up.

facts.subject: Golden Pawn
facts.text: In Grenoble, you can enlist to find the Golden Pawn on Level 5 of the Old Cave for 3000 Gold.

evidence.quote: Since you're at Level 20, it's time to head back to the Old Cave to tackle Level 5. Warp to Grenoble and this time, enlist to find the Golden Pawn for 3000 Gold.

facts.subject: Old Cave
facts.text: Heading down upon entering Level 5 of the Old Cave leads to a Smoke Ball.

evidence.quote: Once in the cave, head down and take the Smoke Ball.

facts.subject: Luck Blade
facts.text: The Luck Blade found in the lower room increases Aguro's attack by 200 and deals about 300 damage, but misses 50% of the time.

evidence.quote: Now, the Luck Blade. This thing is cursed, but it doesn't take down his HP. The thing that's wrong with this baby, is that it misses 50% of the time. But, if you do get a successful hit, it does about 300 damage to the monsters in here. It ups Aguro's attack by 200.

facts.subject: lower muck puddle
facts.text: Checking the top corner of the lower muck puddle on Level 5 of the Old Cave yields an Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Back in the main room, check the top corner of the lower muck puddle for another Ex Potion.

facts.subject: main room
facts.text: Across from the muck puddle on Level 5 of the Old Cave, you can take the Kite Shield.

evidence.quote: On the other side, take the Kite Shield and head into the top room, plundering it.

facts.subject: third door
facts.text: Going through the third door on Level 5 of the Old Cave leads to the Battle Axe.

evidence.quote: Enter the middle room, take the treasure in there, and then go back and through the third door. Take the BATTLE AXE, another super-powerful weapon to add to your collection.

facts.subject: muck
facts.text: Walking up 7 and right 1 in the muck on Level 5 of the Old Cave allows you to take a Revive.

evidence.quote: Go up 7 and right 1 to take the Revive in the muck.

facts.subject: treasure room
facts.text: The old man in Medan Mine gives you his last Ruby and leaves his treasure room open.

evidence.quote: Talk to the old man, and he'll give you his last ruby. ... But the stupid old geezer leaves his treasure room door open! Ha! Go in there and take all his stuff to thank him for giving him your ruby!

facts.subject: Flamefreak
facts.text: Flamefreaks in the Red Tower cast Flame, dealing 30-40 damage to each party member and up to 160 damage when four attack together.

evidence.quote: The only thing really annoying about this place are those accursed Flamefreaks. They're insanely fast, and cast "Flame", and attack that hits everyone for 30-40 damage. Get four of them on you at once, they're dealing you 160 damage every turn.

facts.subject: second floor
facts.text: Entering the right room on the second floor of the Red Tower leads to Float.

evidence.quote: Go to the second floor, and enter the right room to get the Float.

facts.subject: left path
facts.text: Going down the left path on the second floor of the Red Tower leads to a Power Gourd and a Magic Guard.

evidence.quote: Go down the left path and take the Power Gourd and Magic Guard.

facts.subject: hallway
facts.text: Going down past the plaque hallway in the Red Tower yields a Hi Magic and a Hi Potion.

evidence.quote: Go down and take the Hi Magic and Hi Potion.

facts.subject: stairs
facts.text: Climbing the stairs directly above the third-floor entrance in the Red Tower leads to another Hi Potion.

evidence.quote: Now go back to the second floor, and enter the lower left room and climb the steps to the third floor. Go up the stairs directly above you and get another Hi Potion.

facts.subject: Dark Ghost
facts.text: The Dark Ghost casts a 50-60 HP Water spell and is defeated on the fifth floor of the Red Tower, saving the Water Fairy.

evidence.quote: The only thing hard about him is his 50-60 HP Water spell. ... Send this guy back to Hell and then the Water Fairy will thank you.

facts.subject: basement lake
facts.text: After falling out of the Red Tower and returning to the basement lake, the chests refill and the Blue Jade is found.

evidence.quote: Now. . .fall out of the tower, then go back in down to the basement lake. The chests you took earlier have been re-filled, and the Blue Jade is now there.

facts.subject: Jades
facts.text: The jades must be set into the towers in the specific order of Blue, Green, then Red to warp to Elfrea.

evidence.quote: Now, you have to head back to every tower and set the jades in, making sure you do it in the order of Blue, Green, Red. *GROAN*. Refer back to my guides to those towers if you forget your way through. Use your large collection of Sweet Waters to keep the monsters away if you're sick of random battles, even though they hardly ever do a good job of it. After you put the red jade on, you're automatically warped to Elfrea, and my least favorite part of the game is finally over!

facts.subject: Artea's house
facts.text: Potions can be found inside Artea's house in Elfrea.

evidence.quote: Take the potions in Artea's house and then talk to him upstairs.

facts.subject: Artea
facts.text: Speaking to Artea upstairs yields the Shrine Key and an improved weapon for Jerin.

evidence.quote: He tells you tons of information about your journey, and then gives you the Shrine Key and a better weapon for Jerin.

facts.subject: Magic Wall
facts.text: From the hallway between the front room and the stone room, navigate the Magic Wall puzzle by moving Up-1, Right-2, Up-1, Right-2, Up-4, Left-3, Down-1, Left-2, Down-1, Left-2, Up-2, Right-1, Up-1, Right-2, then heading straight up the steps.

evidence.quote: From the small hallway from the front room to the room with the four stones, go: Up-1, Right-2, Up-1, Right-2, Up-4, Left-3, Down-1, Left-2, Down-1, Left-2, Up-2, Right-1, Up-1, Right-2, and then head straight up the steps.

facts.subject: Odel Castle flowers
facts.text: The flowers on the right side of the castle contain Great, Speed, and Mind Potions.

evidence.quote: Head to the right side and take the Great, Speed, and Mind Potions from the flowers.

facts.subject: Odel Castle first floor cabinets
facts.text: The first floor of Odel Castle contains Power and Spell Potions, as well as two Hi Magics inside cabinets.

evidence.quote: On the first floor, take the Power and Spell Potions, and then the two Hi Magics from the cabinents.

facts.subject: Lyden area enemies
facts.text: Enemies encountered around Lyden yield approximately 700 to 800 EXP per battle.

evidence.quote: For some reason, all the enemies around Lyden give around 700-800 EXP per battle, which is amazing.

facts.subject: Shaia Lab 2 cabinets
facts.text: Cabinets located down the upper right steps of the castle courtyard in Shaia Lab 2 contain a Mind Gourd and a Power Gourd.

evidence.quote: Before you leave, head down in the castle courtyard and down the upper right steps. You'll be in Shaia Lab 2. What's Shaia Lab? We'll get to that later. In the cabinents you can find a Mind and Power Gourd.

facts.subject: Ice Snake
facts.text: Ice Snakes found in Odel Cave possess only 100 HP.

evidence.quote: The enemies are cheese, too, especially the Ice Snakes, which only have 100 HP.

facts.subject: Mimicker
facts.text: Mimickers in Odel Cave award roughly 2500 EXP points per battle.

evidence.quote: The Mimickers in here  give about 2500 EXP points per battle, though!

facts.subject: Broken bridge area
facts.text: A Dragon Egg and an Ex Potion can be collected near the broken bridge inside Odel Cave.

evidence.quote: Inspect the broken bridge, and then take the Dragon Egg and Ex Potion and leave.

facts.subject: Piron
facts.text: Talking to Piron and his assistant and viewing the bridge from the other side prompts them to build the bridge across the chasm.

evidence.quote: After that's done with, enter the fourth entrance and go to the bridge. Talk to both Piron and his assistant, to find out you have to go back all the way around and look over the bridge. Go there, and then watch them build the bridge.

When you enter the 1st entrance and speal with Piron, he will ask you to watch 
him from that cliff where there are two treasure boxes...Watch they build the bridge and enter the 1st entrance.

facts.subject: North cave entrance
facts.text: Inside the north entrance of Odel Cave, a Half Mail, Glass Robe, Stone Cure, Quilted Silk, and Miracle can be found.

evidence.quote: Go to the far north entrance and enter. Go down and take the Half Mail, then around for the Glass Robe. The Stone Cure is to the left, and the Quilted Silk and Miracle are far down in the left corner.

facts.subject: Second cave entrance
facts.text: A Glass Cap lies far southwest from the second entrance of Odel Cave, with an Iron Helm and Wind Shoes located even farther in that direction.

evidence.quote: There is a Glass Cap far southwest from the 2nd entrance, and an Iron Helm and Wind Shoes even farther than that.

facts.subject: Bridge north side
facts.text: Heading right, up, and around on the north side of the bridge allows you to collect an Escape and Hi Arrows.

evidence.quote: On the north side, go right, up, and around to claim an Escape and Hi Arrows.

facts.subject: Lower level muck
facts.text: A Miracle is located across the muck in the lower level of Odel Cave.

evidence.quote: Now head back down the right passage and into a lower level. Trudge across the muck and grab the Miracle, then continue on.

facts.subject: Ground floor exits
facts.text: Returning to the ground floor reveals a Revive, an Ex Potion down to the far left, and a second Revive after ascending the next ladder.

evidence.quote: After Lufia does her crazy spell thing and you make it through the basement level, you should be back on the ground floor. Take the Revive. Now go all the way left and down to get an Ex Potion. Take another Revive after climbing the next ladder.

facts.subject: Arus northern house flower
facts.text: The flower in the top right-hand corner of the large northern house in Arus contains a Mind Potion.

evidence.quote: At the large house up north, the flower in the top right-hand corner contains a Mind Potion.

facts.subject: Old Cave 6th floor room
facts.text: Three Hi Bombs can be picked up while ascending the 6th floor of the Old Cave, and entering the first room yields the Gladius along with three potions.

evidence.quote: On the 6th floor of the Old Cave, take the 3 Hi Bombs as you go up, and enter the first room. In the room, you'll find the Gladius, a new sword for Hero. AND IT'S NOT CURSED! You'll find some more new equipment in this room as well as  3 potions.

facts.subject: Old Cave 6th floor muck
facts.text: An Ex Magic and Ex Potion are found in the muck, and two spaces up on the right from the right chest lies a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Take the Ex Magic and Ex Potion in the muck, but that isn't all that's there. From the right chest, two spaces up on the right is a Miracle.

facts.subject: Old Cave 6th floor left room
facts.text: The Hammer Rod for Lufia is found on the left side of the floor.

evidence.quote: On the left, you'll find the critically-acclaimed HAMMER ROD, which is a stronger rod for Lufia sporting a stylish hammer on the end!

facts.subject: Old Cave downstairs
facts.text: Downstairs in the Old Cave, you can obtain an Ex Magic, Power Gourd, Ex Potion, Knife Shoes, and Needle Shoes.

evidence.quote: Downstairs, get the Ex Magic, Power Gourd, Ex Potion, as well as the brilliant Knife and Needle Shoes.

facts.subject: Old Cave final chest set
facts.text: A Mind Gourd, Blast Ring, and Miracle Gem can be retrieved from the final treasure set, along with a Miracle hidden in the muck three steps below the Blast Ring.

evidence.quote: Back on ground floor, take the Mind Gourd and proceed to the last set of treasures. Take the Blast Ring and Miracle Gem, and don't forget to get the Miracle, which is in the muck three steps below the Blast Ring.

facts.subject: Tower of Grief entrance rooms
facts.text: The right path of the Tower of Grief holds a Purple Ring, while going up the stairs in the center room grants a Dragon Egg, Revive, and Stone Cure.

evidence.quote: Collect the Purple Ring from the right path, then enter the center room and go up the steps to recieve a Dragon Egg, Revive, and Stone Cure.

facts.subject: Tower of Grief third floor stairways
facts.text: Ascending the southwest stairways on the third floor leads to an Ex Potion and Hi Magic, whereas the northeast stairway yields a Revive and Stone Cure.

evidence.quote: On the third floor, you'll be greeted with not one, not two, not three, but FOUR stairways. Go up the southwest stairways to get an Ex Potion and Hi Magic, and then the northeast for another Revive and Stone Cure.

facts.subject: Tower of Grief refiller
facts.text: A full HP and MP restoration point is available on the fifth floor of the Tower of Grief.

evidence.quote: On the fifth floor, you get a HP/MP refiller, which, you don't really need since the enemies here are weak.

facts.subject: Tower of Grief top floor
facts.text: The chest on the top floor of the Tower of Grief contains a Miracle.

evidence.quote: On the top floor you'll see an old man and a treasure chest. Hmmm. . .stylish old man. . .treasure. . .stylish old man. . .treasure. . .TREASURE! Take the treasure for a Miracle.

facts.subject: Platina cabinets
facts.text: Four cabinets at the top of the right stairs in Platina contain a Hi Magic, Ex Arrows, Gloom Arrow, and Hi Bomb.

evidence.quote: Go up the right stairs, and check the four unusual cabinents to get a Hi Magic, Ex Arrows, Gloom Arrow, and Hi Bomb.

facts.subject: Professor Raile
facts.text: Raile tests the Falcon in the basement of Platina, leaving the party with a ship capable of exploring the surface sea.

evidence.quote: He'll take you to the basement and try out the Falcon, but in the end all he leaves you with is a leaky ship that can't travel underwater. Ah well. At least you can explore the sea.

facts.subject: Forfeit second floor shop
facts.text: Customers are forced to purchase an item to leave the shop with the purple-and-green checked floor on the second floor of Forfeit, with the cheapest items priced at 2 and 5 Gold.

evidence.quote: Be warned about the shop on the 2nd floor with the purple-and-green checked floor, because the girls in there will FORCE you to buy something to leave! Luckilly, there are items there that are 2 and 5 Gold each.

facts.subject: Secret stairwell shop
facts.text: Entering the secret stairwell behind the building in Forfeit leads south to the back of the item shop to obtain a Mind Ring.

evidence.quote: Go around the building and enter the secret stairwell behind the place. South leads to the back of the item shop's place, giving you a Mind Ring.

facts.subject: Carbis island
facts.text: A Mind Potion can be acquired upon reaching Carbis on Shaia Lab 3.

evidence.quote: Warp back to Platina and head west to the small island that Carbis, or Shaia Lab 3, is on. Grab the Mind Potion and then go down to the basement.

facts.subject: Cooper
facts.text: Cooper is trapped in the room where the Gold Pawn was previously found in the Old Cave after his escape fails.

evidence.quote: When you talk to the priest, you'll find that Cooper is at the Old Cave. Great. More chasing. I guess this is to force people who aren't even at Level 20 to get there. Just follow it to the last room where you took the Gold Pawn before. Cooper will be in there waiting. After his escape craps out and you save his sorry behind, you can head back to Carbis.

facts.subject: Falcon repair
facts.text: Repairing the hole in the Falcon requires collecting seven pieces of Allumina.

evidence.quote: Once Cooper is back with Raile, you'll find out that you need seven pieces of Allumina to fix the hole in the Falcon.

facts.subject: Guardian
facts.text: The Guardian has around 2000 HP.

evidence.quote: This guy has around 2000 HP, so get ready for a long fight.

facts.subject: Guardian
facts.text: The Guardian casts Flame and Blizzard, hitting all party members for around 50-80 HP.

evidence.quote: considering that his Flame and Blizzard spells, (which attack all, mind you) deal around 50-80 HP to everyone!

facts.subject: Guardian
facts.text: Having Hero and Lufia consecutively use Drain for about four rounds depletes the Guardian of his defense.

evidence.quote: At the start of the battle, have Hero and Lufia consecutively use Drain for about four rounds. This'll totally deplete the Guardian of his defense, which will extremely up the damage you're doing to him.

facts.subject: Guardian
facts.text: Defeating the Guardian on the ninth floor allows the party to obtain the Light Key.

evidence.quote: where you'll meet the Guardian, a little cronie of the Sinistrals... After the battle Amos and Gades will come and beat the snot out of you. Take the Light Key and fall out of the tower.

facts.subject: Treasure Chest
facts.text: Dropping down the hole on the first floor leads to six treasures scattered in the corners of the room.

evidence.quote: Start off your climb by dropping down the hole in front of you! Take the six treasures scattered in the corners of the room, and proceed up the steps.

facts.subject: Stone Cure
facts.text: A Stone Cure can be grabbed in the room before taking the stairs to the third level.

evidence.quote: As is usually the case in this tower, the doors lead to the same room, which you can grab a Stone Cure and go to the third level.

facts.subject: Revive
facts.text: Two Revives are located on the third floor, one in the room above and another down below.

evidence.quote: Go into the room above and take the Revive. Go down and take another Revive, then into the right room, but watch out!

facts.subject: Ex Magic
facts.text: Taking the left path on the third floor yields an Ex Magic and an Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Take the left path and recieve and Ex Magic and Ex Potion.

facts.subject: Miracle
facts.text: A Miracle is located at the end of the long path in the right room of the fifth floor.

evidence.quote: Follow the unneccessarily long path and take the Miracle at the end, then go aaaaaaaaall the way back to the fifth floor.

facts.subject: Ex Potion
facts.text: A fourth Ex Potion can be found on the right side of the fifth floor before falling down a hole.

evidence.quote: Continue up the right side for your fourth Ex Potion, then simply fall down a hole.

facts.subject: Power Gourd
facts.text: Following the path in the south room of the sixth floor leads to a Power Gourd.

evidence.quote: Take the south room and follow the path to get the Power Gourd.

facts.subject: Gloom Voice
facts.text: A Gloom Voice is located on the seventh floor, surrounded by holes on all sides except the top.

evidence.quote: The first treasure you see is surrounded by holes, except for the top, so go up there and get the Gloom Voice.

facts.subject: Treasure Chest
facts.text: Down the stairs in the northeast house of Linze, following the red path leads to three treasures.

evidence.quote: When you're ready, head down the stairs in the northeast house, until you come to a red and green path. The red path leads to three treasures.

facts.subject: Stone Cure
facts.text: A Stone Cure and an Escape are located in the upper-left corner of the entry floor.

evidence.quote: Take the Stone Cure and Escape up in the left corner, to get to them just walk left, up, left, up, etc.

facts.subject: Ex Potion
facts.text: An Ex Potion and a Hi Magic are located straight to the right from the entrance steps.

facts.subject: Aisen Tower

facts.subject: Oil Dragon
facts.text: Against the Oil Dragon, the Dragon ring, dragon tooth, and dragon arrow are useless, and Lufia should always cast Thunder or Sunder unless the dragon casts Mirror.

evidence.quote:
Be 
careful, as the Oil Dragon can cast Mirror to reflect your spells back at you,
in which case, Lufia should join in on the healing until the Mirror wears off.

When you start to be dwindling down his HP, he'll use Dash, which takes down about 120-140 from a single character, and an upgraded Fire Air, which does around 90-140 damage to everyone. He also has a nasty habit of using Magic Mirror, especially right after you cast Sunder on him ~_~.

If you're expecting to equip Dragon ring and/or use dragon tooth/arrow, don't...waste your time, it's completely useless against Oil Dragon....Lufia always cast thunder(or sunder) EXCEPT, if he cast...mirror.

facts.subject: Old Cave
facts.text: Entering deeper floors of the Old Cave requires character levels: below 10 for 2nd floor, below 15 for 3rd, below 20 for 4th, below 25 for 5th, below 30 for 6th, and higher than 30 for 7th floor.

evidence.quote: The Old cave is a 7 floor dungeon located north of Grenoble. You must have...some levels to enter in lower floors of the cave, as follows:...2nd floor:  No requirements....3rd floor:  Must be at level 10....4th floor:  Must be at level 15....5th floor:  Must be at level 20....6th floor:  Must be at level 25....7th floor:  Must be at level 30.

In this cave, you can reach the deeper levels as you gain more levels of 
experience. If you are below 10, you can get only to 2nd floor. Below 15, to 
3rd, below 20, to 4th, below 25, to 5th, below 30, to 6th. If you are higher 
than 30, you can enter the 7th, the last one.

Boss
Aprendice

loves to use jolt, or fake spell and attack on the same round. You must keep

lot(that's why save hero's mp). I recomend you be at least on level 11, if 
not, you will have MUCH trouble on killing him.

facts.subject: Might set

evidence.quote: The full Might set is easily missable in a casual playthrough.

evidence.quote: Dragon eggs can replace the original chest contents if not opened prior.

evidence.quote: Black Market can be obtained by visiting the location since that doesn't require a first time visit, but that's it.

evidence.quote: An end game save that has done all of this won't be able to unlock the new achievements without doing it again.

facts.subject: Jerin achievement

evidence.quote: If you are registered for the discord, you should be able to submit a manual unlock request.

facts.subject: Jerin achievement
facts.text: A manual unlock request may ask for a save, but a save is likely unnecessary since later progression achievements exist.

evidence.quote: If you are registered for the discord, you should be able to submit a manual unlock request.
They might ask for a save but since it's a progression achievement and you have other progression achievements after it. You likely won't even need to.

facts.subject: Jerin achievement

facts.subject: Battle attacks
facts.text: Attacks are not redirected to another target when an enemy is defeated, which slows battles.

evidence.quote: In the fights the attacks are not redirected when an enemy is defeated, that sometimes annoys and slows down the speed of the fights a bit, also the ABSURD amount of enemies that appear almost at every step you take.

facts.subject: Random encounters
facts.text: Random encounters are frequent, and healing is needed after every battle.

evidence.quote: Not a terrible RPG on its face, but by the time you are done you -will- be absolutely sick of random encounters and healing up after every single one.

facts.text: Grinding was only needed for rare drops, and the reviewer was over level 50 (Lv78) by the end.

I was also way past Level 50.

facts.text: Sweet Water sharply reduces the encounter rate.

evidence.quote: The water drops the encounter rate dramatically, and the few encounters I got while having its effect, just used a Smoke Bomb.
